There are thirty million shares. What is common value in dollars per share?

follow_up.question: Why must the share count match the equity value used in the calculation?
follow_up.reference: The numerator is the value belonging to common shareholders. The denominator must represent the same claim and dilution convention; mixing basic and diluted measures can distort the per-share value.
